chapterTitle: FBISE Annual Exam Simulator 08 (Board Past Paper Gold Selection)
subject: chemistry-10

questions.question: At dynamic equilibrium, the forward reaction rate is: (FBISE Past Paper Gold)

options.A: Equal to the reverse reaction rate

questions.explanation: Equilibrium requires exact balance of forward and reverse rates.

questions.question: What is the conjugate base of $H_2SO_4$? (FBISE Past Paper Gold)
Phenolphthalein indicator is colorless in: (FBISE Past Paper Gold)
questions.explanation: Phenolphthalein turns pink only in alkaline conditions ($pH > 8.3$).

questions.question: Which of the following is a neutral (normal) salt? (FBISE Past Paper Gold)
questions.explanation: Sodium chloride contains no replaceable hydrogen or hydroxyl ions.

questions.question: Catenation is the remarkable self-linking ability of which element? (FBISE Past Paper Gold)
questions.explanation: Carbon forms strong $C-C$ covalent bonds in chains and rings.

questions.question: Which gas comprises ~85% of natural gas? (FBISE Past Paper Gold)
questions.explanation: Natural gas is predominantly composed of methane.

questions.question: Bromine water test produces which visual result with alkenes? (FBISE Past Paper Gold)
questions.explanation: Addition across double bonds decolorizes bromine water.

questions.question: Deficiency of Vitamin A leads to which eye condition? (FBISE Past Paper Gold)
questions.explanation: Vitamin A is essential for rhodopsin; deficiency impairs dark adaptation.

questions.question: In the stratosphere, the temperature rises with altitude because: (FBISE Past Paper Gold)

options.B: It is closest to the Sun

questions.explanation: Ozone absorption of UV-B and UV-C releases heat, warming the stratosphere.

questions.question: Permanent hardness of water cannot be removed by: (FBISE Past Paper Gold)
questions.explanation: Boiling only precipitates bicarbonates (temporary hardness), not sulphates or chlorides.
